description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying the correctness of the 'git update-index --refresh' command, particularly focusing on handling racy timestamps in index and working directory files.

methods.name: reset_files
methods.description: Resets the 'file' and 'other' files with specific content and updates their modification times.

methods.name: update_assert_changed
methods.description: Sets the index file modification time and runs 'git update-index' with optional flags, then checks that the index mtime has changed.
